tool_limitations.limitation: It recursively copies only files physically below -Source and does not evaluate external project items with Link metadata.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Evaluate Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource items with Visual Studio MSBuild and copy external linked inputs to their Link destinations.

tool_limitations.limitation: A non-platform-qualified dotnet build is not discoverable.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Document and use dotnet build -c Debug -p:Platform=<current architecture> before launch.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3, build-command discipline, and final build
doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build with Debug and an explicit Platform; use Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for launch.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 0 claim that the bootstrap is the complete inventory
doc_errors.wrong: The bootstrap inventory was treated as complete even when the UWP csproj linked shared files outside -Source.
doc_errors.correct: The bootstrap must evaluate and copy external linked project inputs before producing its mapping.

special_apis.special_handling: The Windows namespace APIs carried over unchanged; only the WinUI shell, status surface, and nullable generator lifecycle needed adaptation.

errors_encountered.error: Initial Test-Path returned False immediately after bootstrap.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent launched the bootstrap and self-check in parallel instead of waiting for the mandatory bootstrap command.
errors_encountered.fix: Re-ran Test-Path after bootstrap completed; the mapping existed.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a command absent from the installed winapp CLI.
The SDK-style project already includes XAML Page items implicitly, but the agent added an explicit Page Include.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0503 Compiled Bindings cannot be processed in Property Element form.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent authored x:Bind as an object element under NavigationView.MenuItemsSource instead of using attribute syntax or assigning the source in code.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the property-element x:Bind and assigned NavView.MenuItemsSource in the constructor.

errors_encountered.error: CS8618/CS8600/CS8602 nullable warnings in all three scenario pages.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Generator fields and ComboBoxItem casts retained UWP-era non-null assumptions under a nullable-enabled WinUI project.
errors_encountered.fix: Made generator fields nullable and added selected-item/tag guards.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable: no output under bin\x64\Debug.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The preceding plain dotnet build wrote bin\Debug rather than the platform-qualified layout expected by the launcher.
errors_encountered.fix: Used dotnet run for the immediate launch; the validator later rebuilt with -p:Platform=x64 and its smoke launch passed.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration failed because eight mapping rows remained Status=copied.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent completed the files but did not update migration bookkeeping before the first validation.
errors_encountered.fix: Changed all eight rows to done and re-ran validation.

dev_agent_struggles.where: Source inventory and shell reconstruction, turns 4-12
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched outside the project, opened SharedContent files, recreated shared styles manually, and copied shared assets itself.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Approximately nine turns from source inspection through the first large patch.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap omitted csproj-linked files located outside -Source, including App.xaml, MainPage, Styles.xaml, and shell assets.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent discovered SharedContent via repository search and manually rebuilt/copied the dependencies.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to evaluate and copy external linked project items to their Link destinations.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The documented build command failed, two subsequent builds exposed avoidable project/XAML errors, and Test-AppLaunch could not find output.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Four build attempts plus one unavailable launch.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Incorrect build-command guidance plus missing concise SDK-style Page and x:Bind syntax diagnostics.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent switched to dotnet build, removed the duplicate Page item, assigned MenuItemsSource in code, and eventually used dotnet run.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Use an explicit platform-qualified dotnet build command and add NETSDK1022/WMC0503 recipes.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The app functioned but scored partial on all features because theme, desktop chrome, NavigationView defaults, pane width, and heading wrapping diverged.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Not detected during migration; reported by the scoring trial.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The shell guidance covered navigation behavior but not concrete visual-fidelity defaults for a substituted NavigationView/window.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unresolved in the migration; migration-score.json remained 50 with three partial features.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add a shell-fidelity checklist covering RequestedTheme, Settings visibility, pane geometry, title-bar choice, and source text wrapping.

missing_tooling.need: Automatic inventory/copy of csproj-linked inputs outside the source directory.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Repository-wide SharedContent discovery, manual style recreation, manual asset copies, and the visual drift introduced during reconstruction.

env_issues.issue: The installed winapp CLI exposed run but not build.
env_issues.workaround: Use native dotnet build; use winapp only indirectly for packaged launch.
